findings.title: MetricAlertDetectorHandler is now abstract and cannot be instantiated
findings.body:
`MetricAlertDetectorHandler` now subclasses `StatefulDetectorHandler` with only `pass`. It inherits several abstract members it does not implement: `counter_names`, `get_dedupe_value`, `get_group_key_values` and the new `build_occurrence_and_event_data`.

`MetricAlertFire.detector_handler` points at this class. As a result, `Detector.detector_handler` (`group_type.detector_handler(self)`) raises `TypeError: Can't instantiate abstract class` for any detector of type `metric_alert_fire`.

In `process_detectors` that exception is not caught. One such detector aborts processing for every detector in the batch, and `commit_state_updates` never runs for detectors already evaluated.

Before this change the handler was a concrete no-op that returned `[]`. Either keep it concrete (stub the abstract methods) or don't register it as the group type's handler yet. The TODO comment on line 10 ("This will be a stateful detector when we build that abstraction") is also now stale.

findings.title: Expected occurrence built with wrong group key; fingerprint won't match
findings.body:
In `TestEvaluateGroupKeyValue.test_dedupe`, the expected occurrence is built with `build_mock_occurrence_and_event(handler, "val1", ...)`, so its fingerprint is `["<id>:val1"]`.

The call under test is `evaluate_group_key_value("group_key", 10, ...)`. That invokes `build_occurrence_and_event_data("group_key", ...)`, which produces fingerprint `["<id>:group_key"]`.

`IssueOccurrence` is a frozen dataclass with field-wise equality, and only `StatusChangeMessage.__eq__` is patched. The `DetectorEvaluationResult` comparison therefore fails on the fingerprint. The expected occurrence should be built with `"group_key"`.

findings.title: evaluate docstring still says it returns a list
findings.body: The `StatefulDetectorHandler.evaluate` docstring still says it "returns a list of `DetectorEvaluationResult`". This PR changed the return type to `dict[DetectorGroupKey, DetectorEvaluationResult]` keyed by group key. The docstring should be updated so implementers and callers aren't misled about the contract.
